description: Ask this before the owner invoices or accepts a payment, or when they wonder if they overpay in fees. Give the amount and how the payer can pay (card online, card in person, bank transfer, payment app, or any). Returns every route ranked by fee, cheapest first: provider, method, fee in dollars, what the owner keeps, how to set it up, and whether the number is exact or an estimate. Pass current_route to get the saving per payment and per year. Example: a $1,000 invoice costs $35.39 on PayPal Checkout, $29.30 on Stripe card, $5.00 on Stripe ACH and $0 on a Melio bank-transfer request. Fees are from the providers' own pricing pages, dated, US only.

current_route.description: How the owner gets paid today (e.g. paypal_checkout, stripe_card), to compute savings

fresh.description: Re-read the provider's pricing page (or the live FX quote) now instead of using the last check. Slower. Up to 20 page reads per key per day. Use when the owner is about to act on the number.

payer_pays_by.description: How the payer can pay: card_online, card_in_person, bank, app, or any

payments_per_month.description: Payments of this size per month, for yearly savings

name: cheapest_way_to_get_paid
title: Cheapest way to get paid
